messages:
Maria: Product requested inline "notify cost estimate" on SLO edit. They want a quick monthly range and a delta preview when changing thresholds.
Jon: +1. We've seen teams accidentally crank sensitivity and spike fanout. Would help reduce surprise pages.
Sam: Clarify accuracy needs: ballpark range vs per-minute exactness?
Maria: Ballpark is fine. Product suggested an inline chip near the slider and a details drawer for assumptions.
Lia: UX idea: small chip displaying "$X–$Y / month" with a ? tooltip. Click expands to show expected pages, sample period, and assumptions.
Oliver: Infra note: we can approximate from recent alert rate for the tenant plus routing/escalation multipliers. Use cached counters so the console can poll without DB pressure.
Jon: Important: include quota context. If a tenant is quota-limited, the cost number alone could be confusing. Show a badge if quota is near cap.
Sam: Implementation sketch:
```
estimate = cached_alerts_per_min * escalation_factor * cost_per_notify_delivery
// escalation_factor derived from routing policy (tiered, pooled, soft-fallback)
```
We expose an endpoint: `/api/v1/slo/notify_estimate?slo_id=...` that returns estimate + inputs.
Lia: The endpoint should return both the estimate and the input stats (recent_alerts_per_min, escalation_multiplier) so the console can link to telemetry and explain how we calculated it.
Maria: Product also wants a "delta preview" while dragging the threshold: show delta in expected pages and delta in estimated monthly cost next to the save button.
Oliver: Soft-fallback routing is fuzzy. We should include a conservative fallback multiplier and a confidence label (low/med/high).
Jon: UX guardrail: don't block saves. Instead, surface a small nudge and require an explicit confirmation for big spend deltas (e.g., > 2x current spend or > $300/mo increase).
Sam: API contract suggestion: `notify_estimate_hint` fields: `estimated_monthly_usd`, `expected_pages_month`, `confidence`, `assumptions_link`, `sample_period_seconds`.
Lia: Confidence can be derived from variance of recent alert rate and recent routing changes. Show low/med/high with hover text.
Maria: Telemetry: add metrics `slo.notify.estimate.requests` and `slo.notify.estimate.confidence_label` and expose `slo.notify.estimate_input_version` so we can iterate the estimator safely.
Oliver: Avoid high-cardinality metrics per SLO. Tag by tenant bucket and estimator version, not by SLO id.
Sam: Console will poll while the user drags the slider. Add client-side debounce (250ms) and server-side cached responses with an `X-Estimate-Cache-TTL` header. Also enforce rate limits per-session.
Jon: Owners: Sam (endpoint + API contract), Oliver (counters + compute), Lia (UI + mock), Maria (product coordination + rollout guardrails).
Lia: I'll post a 3-frame gif of the inline chip + drawer in #design for feedback.
Sam: I'll post a sample JSON response by EOD and gate rollout with a feature flag `console.enable_notify_estimates`.
Maria: Product also asked for a "why this changed" line when saving: short diff like "+120 pages / mo (~$45/mo) due to threshold change". Keep it small and actionable.
Oliver: We'll also add an internal metric to capture estimate accuracy post-fact so we can calibrate the multiplier.
Sam: Quick note: the endpoint should accept a `routing_policy_hint` param so console can simulate different routing choices (e.g., force pooled vs tiered) for what-if scenarios.
Jon: I'll draft the confirmation thresholds and share in the thread. Proposal: confirmation for > 2x or > $300/mo delta.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/notify-estimate -> staging at 2025-06-12T18:00Z
thread_text_excerpt: Product requested inline notify cost estimate on SLO edit; ballpark ranges + delta preview; owners: Sam, Oliver, Lia, Maria; deploy scheduled to staging.
